content_type.description: The content type: raw, or template to render the object with the agent's facts and vars; the object's own when empty

interval.description: The interval of a script in /etc/cron.daily and the like; give it or schedule

name.description: The entry, and its file name, such as backup

object.description: The object that holds the entry, from osapi client file upload

schedule.description: A cron expression, such as */5 * * * *; give it or interval

user.description: The user the entry runs as

vars.description: The vars of a template, as key=value
